rule.statement: The twelve months time frame referred to in Section 52 of the Partition Law is applicable only if any interference or dispossession had occurred after the delivery of the possession.
rule.supporting_quote: Whether their Lordships of the Civil Appellate High Court have erred in law by failing to appreciate the fact that the twelve months time frame referred to in Section 52 of the Partition Law is applicable only if any interference or dispossession had occurred after the delivery of the possession?
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Partition Law, No. 21 of 1977, as subsequently amended.
